Title: Lapis Gold Drip Bowl
Body (HTML):
A big, generous bowl that folds and ripples like draped silk. Inside, it's solid shimmering gold. Outside, deep blues swirl through veins of gold, bronze and copper, with a flash of green here and there, like a polished piece of lapis lazuli.

The gold was sprayed onto the sheet first, then a single coat of resin was poured over it and draped by hand while it was still soft, so every fold and wave is one of a kind. At about 25 cm across and 620 g, it's a real statement piece for a sideboard, dining table or mantel.

This is a decorative piece, not for food. The gold interior is a painted finish, so dust it gently with a soft dry cloth.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
